harnessNotes: Initial server launch used an incorrect app path and exited before starting; corrected to installed app. Join required selecting the existing GC. An initial build loader used a non-async constructor and failed before executing the build; corrected loader created the fixtures once. All three temporary Soldier1 fixtures had complete legal builds and no TODO/warnings. No health or dice were changed/reset, and no stress/subdual ledger was initialized. Weapon swaps were declared on preceding rounds.

A voluntary normal-stance exit initially omitted legalConfirmed and rejected after the existing Rapier hit; the harness inspected its exact saved state, then performed the confirmed exit and recorded that same hit without rerolling. Final UI wording gained spaces around fixed damage amounts; focused and full layout checks were repeated. The sole browser console error was the initial join with no user selected, before entering the world.
